The '''jimvu''' was a large,<ref name="CSWE" /> agile,<ref name="Field Guide">''[[The Wildlife of Star Wars: A Field Guide]]''</ref> six-[[Limb/Legends|legged]] [[Reptile/Legends|reptilian]] creature [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to the<ref name="CSWE" /> [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Naboo CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|352|Naboo}}</ref> [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. A capable runner due to their six legs,<ref name="CSWE" /> they were considered defenseless from predators if not for their speed<ref name="Field Guide" /> and their beak [[Nose/Legends|nose]]. The neck of a jimvu was covered in a row of short knobs.<ref name="CSWE" /> Their predators were the [[Veermok/Legends|veermok]] and [[Narglatch/Legends|narglatch]], both of which could be found in the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] [[Gungan Swamp|swamps]] of Naboo.<ref name="Field Guide" />
